text: Bundle faults read from run 20261116-2, collection collect-2 in the log folder (sessions 9f586b12 in echo-0004 and c1a7c39a in rheo-fixture-0003; files on this computer, not a record). Both sessions did what they were asked and wrote nothing outside their folders; what they met is text of the template, so it is yours, for a template version after v5 and a build of each agent from it, which the person's word of 2026-11-16 (docs/ideas/20261116.md: change the structure and the skills from the failure logs, then test again) now covers. (a) run-skill speaks of the records the runner wrote; the runner prints, and writes a record only with its --record flag, which neither run-skill nor CLAUDE.md names. Both this session and the 015 watch saved the output by redirecting it. (b) Nothing in the bundle says what the exit statuses of the two runners mean; the refusal of a skill with a missing input ended with status 3 and the session could not look it up. (c) A replay item made by hand: nothing says how what came back is compared with the item's expected, or that src/replay.py makes that comparison; the echo session compared by eye. (d) README.md and TEMPLATE.json stand in a bundle and its CLAUDE.md names neither. (e) CAPABILITIES.json of rheo-fixture names tools that change the device and a source path under meta_agent/tests/, none of which is in the bundle; a path of the builder's tree does not belong in a bundle that stands alone, and a held capability should be told apart from one the bundle has. (f) The status contract: fault is required and not declared, temperature and gap come back undeclared and without a unit. B16 binds from the next version, so the contract is revised with it; say by note if the Designer cannot specify an existing request again, and what you need from this seat for it. (g) CLAUDE.md says a grade is derived and the bundle carries no grade table, so the session derived none. Either the bundle carries the table, or CLAUDE.md says a grade is the builder's and is not derived there; your choice, with the reason in the build card's diff. (h) A line of a bundle's failures.jsonl: until a schema lands, the template's text names the keys, at (time), task, needed, looked (where), refused (by what, in its words), would_settle. That naming is this seat's. Not asked: anything about the fixture request's own content (the science task's wording, the unchecked citation). The clone session's faults follow in another note when it has stopped.
